subject: Amber Medical — model quant rollout causing latency & error spike
messages:
From: Signe Park <signe.park@ambermed.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 Jun 2028 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: sudden latency & 5xx spike after today's model change

Hi Jonas,

We started seeing a sharp increase in p95 latency and user-facing 500 errors on our inference calls shortly after your team rolled the new quant profile this morning. The impact started right at ~08:00 PT and has persisted — p95 in our dashboards jumped from ~320ms to ~1.9s and error rate went from 0.2% to ~4.7%. Throughput has also dropped under load.

Attached is a short CSV with p95 buckets for the last 2 hours and a small sample request/response we captured. We're currently throttling traffic to avoid downstream customer impact, but this is a production-blocker for our main workflow.

Can your team confirm a rollback or an immediate mitigation? This is affecting our SLA and we need an ETA for resolution.

Thanks,
Signe Park
Head of Integrations
Amber Medical

Attachments: p95_latency_snapshot.csv
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Signe Park <signe.park@ambermed.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 Jun 2028 08:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: sudden latency & 5xx spike after today's model change

Thanks for flagging, Signe — really sorry for the disruption. We're investigating immediately.

I've looped in Rishi (on-call infra) and Marissa (customer ops). Can you confirm which model/endpoint you hit (model id + config) and whether you saw any 429s along with the 5xx? Any sample request IDs would help.

We will prioritize a rollback if we can't stabilize quickly. I'll update you within 30 minutes with next steps.

— Jonas
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 Jun 2028 09:24:00 -0700
Subject: Re: sudden latency & 5xx spike after today's model change

On Tue, Jun 12, 2028 at 8:28 AM Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Thanks for flagging, Signe — really sorry for the disruption. We're investigating immediately.
> 
> I've looped in Rishi (on-call infra) and Marissa (customer ops). Can you confirm which model/endpoint you hit (model id + config) and whether you saw any 429s along with the 5xx? Any sample request IDs would help.

Quick triage update: we rolled a quant profile change to the redwood-vicuna-3b family at 07:55 PT with the new q-profile v3-q8-opt. Canary metrics looked fine on synthetic tests, but real customer traffic is exposing a corner-case where the kernel selection path increases decode latency for sequences that hit a high-branch in attention (long system prompts + streaming enabled). That path also occasionally triggers a transient memory stall which returns internal server errors (500) for a tiny subset of calls.

I attached a short trace from one of the failing requests — you'll see the decode loop timeouts aligning with larger KV cache growth on those flows. We haven't seen 429s; this is internal server error and latency.

Immediate mitigation options:
- rollback the q-profile to v2-q4 (fastest, safest)
- temporarily route Amber traffic to the older model shard/variant (requires manual routing change, a 5–10 min ops window)
- deploy a per-customer prefix cache override (medium effort)

Given impact, I'm recommending rollback of the q-profile for Amber while we separate the kernel path. I'll prepare a rollback play and coordinate with infra — need an approve from CS/product for SLA communications.

Attachments: trace_snapshot.log

— Rishi
Senior Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 Jun 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Amber Medical — request for rollback + exec notification

Team,

Amber is already throttling and this is impacting their primary clinical inference pipeline. Legal/Procurement will likely request a formal RCA and may ask for service credits if SLA targets were breached. I'm prepping a short customer-facing note that outlines: impact, mitigation, ETA, and next steps.

Please confirm rollback now so I can tell the customer we have a concrete action. If we proceed with rollback, I also request a small goodwill credit discussion with Finance — tagging Lauren to get approval for expedited credit up to $10k if needed.

If anyone objects to rollback (e.g., broader risk), voice it now — otherwise Rishi please proceed with the rollback plan and Jonas keep Signe updated.

— Marissa
Director, Customer Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Signe Park <signe.park@ambermed.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 Jun 2028 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: sudden latency & 5xx spike after today's model change

Signe — quick update and next steps: we performed an emergency rollback of the q-profile for your endpoints at 10:42 PT and confirmed p95 and error rates are returning to baseline across the shard. Rishi's team will continue monitoring for the next 24 hours and we've scheduled a deep-dive to identify the exact kernel selection trigger.

Action items for Amber:
- We will keep your traffic routed to the rolled-back profile for 48 hours unless you request otherwise.
- We'll share a short RCA draft by EOD tomorrow and propose a remediation timeline for the q-profile Kubernetes rollout.

We understand the severity here — apologies again for the impact. Marissa will follow up on any SLA credit request and Lauren is looped for approvals.

Public status: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/20280612-amber (we kept customer ID masked)
Support ticket: HS-98234

Please reply if you see anything unusual or if you prefer a voice call now.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0132
